name: How much does it cost to customize a tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?
description: Customization costs vary based on chosen upgrades and materials, from basic finishes to extensive structural changes or high-end appliances.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to customize a tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of customizing a tiny home varies significantly based on the chosen upgrades and materials. Basic customization of finishes may add a smaller percentage to the base price, while extensive structural changes, high-end appliances, or complex smart home systems can substantially increase the overall cost. During the design phase, we provide a detailed quote outlining all customization costs before construction begins. We work with various budgets to find solutions that balance your desires with financial considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Customization costs vary based on chosen upgrades and materials, from basic finishes to extensive structural changes or high-end appliances.
